data_sources.name: ICFA Crop Recommendation dataset v2 (training data)
data_sources.download_status: The local CSV matches the published file MD5; this dataset is training data, not a geospatial soil source.
data_sources.coverage_status: 2,200 rows without coordinates. N/P/K are described as nutrient-content ratios; units and chemical forms are undocumented.

data_sources.name: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0
data_sources.coverage_status: Local 0-5 cm pH and total-nitrogen raster extracts; neither is an eligible model N/P/K source.

data_sources.name: Government of India Soil Health Card portal
data_sources.download_status: No authorized bulk point-data download verified
data_sources.coverage_status: Public landing page does not document downloadable point records, coordinates, units, depths, dates, methods, or missing-value representation.

data_sources.name: Tamil Nadu Agricultural Department / Tamil Mannvalam
data_sources.download_status: The public AGRISNET landing page was reachable, but no downloadable georeferenced soil file or data license was verified.
data_sources.coverage_status: No public file with sample coordinates, N/P/K analyte definitions, laboratory methods, units, depths, dates, and reuse terms was verified.

data_sources.name: NRSC/Bhuvan soils and nutrient-status mapping
data_sources.license: Bhuvan terms restrict copying, redistribution, and bulk downloads without prior written authorization
data_sources.download_status: No permitted georeferenced point-data file verified
data_sources.coverage_status: Reviewed sources describe district-level nutrient maps and geo-registered workflows, not a published point dataset with model-compatible methods and units.

data_sources.name: FAO Global Soil Nutrient Map (GSNmap)
data_sources.license: Underlying map-data license not verified; the technical manual is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO
data_sources.download_status: No compatible India data download verified
data_sources.coverage_status: Reviewed project documentation does not identify a point archive of Indian lab tests, compatible analyte forms, resolution, depth, dates, or units.

data_sources.license: NASA Earth science data are shared under NASA's full-and-open data policy; cite NASA POWER and its source dataset. Do not imply NASA endorsement.

dataset_coverage.no_coverage: Points outside the installed WGS84 bounds or in zero/NoData raster cells return unavailable. The report counts missing cells but does not calculate polygon boundaries for scattered gaps.

climate_coverage.source: NASA POWER regional monthly service; meteorology from GMAO MERRA-2
climate_coverage.license: NASA Earth science data are shared under NASA's full-and-open data policy; cite NASA POWER and its source dataset. Do not imply NASA endorsement.
climate_coverage.no_coverage: A point has no climate lookup when it is farther than the configured maximum match distance from every installed grid cell. This describes point lookup limits, not the percentage of farms or land covered.

limitations: The installed SoilGrids rasters provide pH and total nitrogen, not compatible model N/P/K measurements.
The training CSV has no coordinates; its source describes N/P/K as nutrient-content ratios but does not document units or nutrient forms.
No compatible georeferenced point-sample dataset is installed; no independent geographic accuracy evaluation can be performed.
Coverage percentages use cells in the installed raster grid as the denominator, not all possible map locations.
